selectionRationale: The target breadth is the normalized public locale-module filename union from the pinned Web Awesome 3.11.0 and Shoelace 2.20.1 releases; translated upstream text was not consulted.
Persian and Hebrew occur in both pinned sets, satisfy explicit consumer demand, and extend full-catalog right-to-left coverage beyond the existing Arabic catalog.

Italian is promoted out of the deferred set once a complete original catalog and its independent review are recorded, matching German, French, Spanish and Portuguese with a full catalog for another major Western European language.
Every remaining union member is deferred until a complete original catalog and an independent translation review can be recorded instead of shipping English scaffold text.

translator.evidence: Drafted afresh from DEFAULT_STRINGS, then terminology-corrected and structurally validated in this repository; no upstream translated text was consulted. The 9.0 catalog changes through the 1,264-key source snapshot were translated in source order and submitted for independent follow-up review. Updated 2026-08-19 for a single added key, emojiPickerGroupUnknown ("Group {group}", a fallback heading for an emoji group id the built-in table does not recognise). An AI-assisted independent review on 2026-08-19 checked the new string across all 10 shipped catalogs for meaning, UI register, preservation of the single {group} placeholder, and per-locale placeholder spacing conventions verified against existing entries in each catalog. One correction was required: Simplified Chinese initially spaced the numeric placeholder ("分组 {group}"), which contradicts the established convention in that catalog (第{line}行, 前{count}个); it was corrected to 分组{group}. Japanese retains its space, matching that catalog's own convention ({line} 行目). After correction all 10 were approved. Updated 2026-08-21 for timelineClusterCount. An independent AI-assisted review compared all 10 shipped catalogs for meaning, UI register, exact {count} preservation, and locale-specific spacing; parenthetical counts were chosen to avoid numeral morphology, with Japanese counter spacing and Simplified Chinese no-space conventions preserved. No human or native-speaker review is claimed. Updated 2026-08-26 for emailViewerUnnamedAttachment ("Unnamed attachment"), the fallback filename shown for an email attachment whose parser supplies no filename and reused inside its open-action accessible name. An AI-assisted review checked DEFAULT_STRINGS and all 10 shipped catalogs for that precise meaning, natural compact UI wording, grammar and register, with explicit attention to Arabic, Persian, and Hebrew RTL wording. All 10 translations were semantically accurate and natural, so no catalog correction, placeholder handling, or English-identical allowlist entry was required. No human or native-speaker identity is claimed. Updated 2026-09-02 for resizeValuePixels ("{value} pixels"), resizeValuePercent ("{value} percent"), mentionResultCount (pluralized "{count} suggestion(s)"), and mentionResultPosition ("Suggestion {current} of {total}"). Original translations were drafted for all 10 catalogs in source order; the shared resize units use locale-natural unit wording, and the mention messages preserve CLDR plural forms and locale-specific position order. No upstream translated text was consulted; no human or native-speaker identity is claimed. Updated 2026-09-05 for promptStudioPreviewLimit ("Preview unavailable: expansion limit exceeded."). Original translations were drafted from the English meaning and prompt-preview context for all 10 shipped catalogs in source order. The text describes unavailable preview after exceeding the text-expansion bound, without implying a network failure or loss of editing/save/run data. No upstream translated text was consulted; no human or native-speaker identity is claimed. Updated 2026-09-07 for heatmapSelectedCount and mapResetNorth. Original translations were added to all 10 catalogs for a selected-cell count label and an action that reorients the map toward north. Label-and-count phrasing avoids number-dependent noun inflection. The implementing contributor checked meaning, compact UI wording, source order, exact {count} preservation, and RTL wording. No upstream text or human/native-speaker review is claimed. Updated 2026-09-14 for a single added key, tableLoadFailed ("Could not load data"), the built-in heading for lr-table's new failed-load state. It was translated across all 10 shipped catalogs in source order, placed after tableLoading to match DEFAULT_STRINGS. The string carries no placeholders, so no placeholder-set or spacing check applied; the Persian and Hebrew renderings were checked for UI register and RTL punctuation against the neighbouring tableLoading and retry entries in each catalog. Updated 2026-09-14 for appRailCollapse ("Collapse navigation") and appRailExpand ("Expand navigation"), the accessible names of lr-app-rail's new opt-in desktop collapse control. Both were translated across all 10 shipped catalogs in source order, placed after resizeNavigation to match DEFAULT_STRINGS. Neither carries a placeholder or plural branch, so no placeholder-set or spacing check applied; the Persian and Hebrew renderings reuse each catalog's established collapse/expand verbs (checked against dockPanelCollapse and dockPanelExpand) with the navigation noun those catalogs already use for closeNavigation and openNavigation. No upstream translated text was consulted; no human or native-speaker identity is claimed. Updated 2026-09-14 for sequenceStripBucketLabel ("{label}, items {start} to {end}") and sequenceStripBucketSummary ("{items} items in {ranges} ranges"), the accessible name of an lr-sequence-strip cell that stands for a range of items once the sequence exceeds the cell cap, and the disclosure that reports how many items were collapsed into how many ranges. Both were translated across all 10 shipped catalogs in source order, placed after sequenceStripUnnamedCategory to match DEFAULT_STRINGS. Neither key is pluralized in English, so each catalog renders one fixed form: Arabic and Persian keep the singular noun a numeral governs, and Russian uses the genitive plural that catalog already uses for unpluralized count strings such as toolSelectLimit. The implementing contributor checked meaning, compact UI register, source order, exact preservation of the {label}/{start}/{end} and {items}/{ranges} placeholder sets, per-locale placeholder spacing, and Arabic, Persian, and Hebrew RTL wording: Arabic and Persian take the Arabic comma as the clause separator, Hebrew keeps the ASCII comma and the prefix-plus-hyphen form before a numeral that catalog already uses elsewhere, and Japanese keeps its space around numerals. One correction was required: Simplified Chinese initially spaced both numeric placeholders, which contradicts the established convention in that catalog (no space between a numeral and the surrounding characters); both entries were respaced to match. No new English-identical allowlist entry was required. No upstream translated text was consulted, and no human, native-speaker, or independent review is claimed for this increment. Updated 2026-09-15 for fileInputRejectedMaxFiles ("{filename}: the maximum number of files has been reached.") and fileInputRejectedMaxTotalSize ("{filename}: adding this file would exceed the total size limit."), the lr-file-input/lr-drop-zone aggregate-limit rejection messages. Both were translated across all 10 shipped catalogs in source order, placed after fileInputRejectedLimit to match DEFAULT_STRINGS, preserving the leading {filename} placeholder and each catalog's established colon/spacing convention from the neighbouring fileInputRejected* entries. No upstream translated text was consulted; no human or native-speaker identity is claimed. Updated 2026-09-15 for matchMismatch ("The values do not match."), the lr-input declarative cross-field match-constraint mismatch message shown when two paired fields (for example a password and its confirmation) disagree. It was translated across all 10 shipped catalogs in source order, placed after valueInvalid to match DEFAULT_STRINGS. The string carries no placeholders. No upstream translated text was consulted; no human or native-speaker identity is claimed. Re-synced for the added `paginationAppliedUnknownTotal` key (the page indicator a server-mode pagination shows when the total is unknown); its translation was derived from this catalog's own existing `paginationApplied` wording, with the total-pages clause dropped. Updated 2026-09-16 for two added keys, appRailItemExpand/appRailItemCollapse ("Expand {label}"/"Collapse {label}", the app-rail item's new child-list disclosure): this catalog's already-reviewed wording for the identical phrase, its own threadGroupExpand/threadGroupCollapse pair, was reused verbatim rather than drafted anew, so no previously unreviewed text entered the catalog.
